translationRepairs: Each year Daozong first visited Black Mountain, paid respects at the tombs of Emperors Shengzong and Xingzong, and rewarded golden lotus.
Each year Daozong first visited Black Mountain, paid respects at the tombs of Emperors Shengzong and Xingzong, and admired the golden lotus.
In 賞金蓮 after the tomb visit, 賞 means to view or enjoy the golden lotus, not to bestow a reward; 'rewarded golden lotus' invents a gift act unsupported by the Chinese.
some had a bu but were organized as a zu—such were the Xi King and Shimo;
some had a bu but were organized as a zu—such were the Xi King and Shiwei;
室韋 is the ethnonym Shiwei; Shimo is a wrong reading of the same characters.
some had a bu but were a zu—such were the Xi King and Shimo;
some had a bu but were a zu—such were the Xi King and Shiwei;
The literal repeats the same error: 室韋 is Shiwei, not Shimo.

When Tang was in the Kaiyuan and Tianbao era, the Dahe clan had already declined; Liao founding ancestor Nieli installed Dilian Zuli as Khan Zuwu.
迪輦祖裏 is one personal name; Dichianzu Li wrongly splits 裏 as Li, while Dilian Zuli matches the four-character name as conventionally romanized.
